name: Agent settings page loads
steps: Click Agent setup (gear icon) in sidebar
Verify settings page loads with agent configuration options
expected: Settings page loads showing agent name, model, voice, and other configuration

name: Gateway restart button works
steps: Verify agent reconnects and responds to messages
expected: Gateway restarts, agent reconnects within 15-30 seconds, can send/receive messages after restart

name: Agent recovery dialog on disconnect
preconditions: Logged into dashboard with active agent
steps: Simulate disconnect (restart gateway or kill agent process)
Check if recovery dialog/banner appears in dashboard
expected: Recovery dialog or banner appears indicating agent is disconnected, with option to reconnect

name: Config sync on agent update
steps: Change agent name or model in settings
Verify the change takes effect (agent uses new model, name updates)
expected: Configuration changes sync to the running agent without manual restart

name: Channels settings page loads
expected: Channels settings page loads showing available integrations (Slack, Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp)

name: User settings page loads
expected: User settings page loads at /dashboard/settings with account options
